As the day winds down, a caring farmer makes sure every animal has a place to rest: soft hay for the piglets, a warm stable for the sleepy horses, and a cozy spot for the cows to settle in.  When his evening chores are done, he heads home with his faithful dog. 

A sweet choice for:
• Little ones who enjoy farm animals and familiar nursery rhymes
• Quiet time together with a story about caring for animals
• Calm moments after a busy day of play
• Winding down in your bedtime routine
